+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"

+
+    <groupId>com.example</groupId>

+    <version>1.0.0</version>

+
+    <name>mysql-jdbc-demo</name>
+    <description>Example Maven project that connects to and queries a MySQL database via JDBC</description>

+        </dependency>
+
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
+            <artifactId>slf4j-simple</artifactId>
+            <version>${slf4j.version}</version>
+        </dependency>
+    </dependencies>
+
+    <build>
+        <finalName>${project.artifactId}-${project.version}</finalName>
+        <plugins>
+            <plugin>

+                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.13.0</version>
+            </plugin>
+
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+                <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>${exec.plugin.version}</version>
+                <configuration>
+                    <mainClass>com.example.App</mainClass>
+                </configuration>
+            </plugin>
+
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>${shade.plugin.version}</version>
+                <executions>
+                    <execution>
+                        <phase>package</phase>
+                        <goals>
+                            <goal>shade</goal>
+                        </goals>
+                        <configuration>
+                            <createDependencyReducedPom>false</createDependencyReducedPom>

+                                </transformer>

+                    </execution>
+                </executions>
+            </plugin>
+        </plugins>
+    </build>

Done. Created a standard Maven project at `/work` and verified it builds (`mvn clean package` → runnable shaded jar).

**Files**
- `pom.xml` — Java 17, `com.mysql:mysql-connector-j:9.1.0`, exec + shade plugins for a runnable jar
- `src/main/java/com/example/DatabaseConfig.java:1` — loads `db.properties`, overridable via `DB_URL`/`DB_USER`/`DB_PASSWORD`
- `src/main/java/com/example/App.java:1` — connects, prints server info, lists tables, runs a parameterized query
- `src/main/resources/db.properties:1` — connection settings
- `schema.sql:1` — sample `users` table
- `.gitignore` — ignores `target/` and IDE files

**Run it**
```
mvn clean package
java -jar target/mysql-jdbc-demo-1.0.0.jar
```
Set the real credentials in `db.properties` (or env vars) and apply `schema.sql` first.

Note: Java/Maven aren't installed system-wide in this environment, so I verified the build using portable copies in `/tmp/opencode` (Temurin JDK 21 + Maven 3.9.9). Running the jar confirmed the driver loads and config resolves; it only fails to connect because no MySQL server is present, as expected.
